channel.title: The Luverne Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Luverne Journal (luvernejournal.com)

item.title: Crenshaw County Arrests Feb. 18 - 22
item.description: Crenshaw County logs Feb. 18‑22 arrests, from outside agency holds and investigative holds to drug charges, unauthorized vehicle use, traffic offenses and court sentencing.

item.title: Luverne celebrates Grit and Grind grand opening
item.description: Grit and Grind Coffee opens in Luverne with a ribbon cutting, offering online and in-person orders from its new food truck behind Luverne Veterinary Hospital.

item.title: What's Happening in Crenshaw County
item.description: From a tree giveaway and Swamp Supper to library clubs, health screenings and a senior summit, see upcoming Crenshaw County events and how to submit your own.

item.title: Luverne, Highland Home finish season in Elite Eight
item.description: Luverne boys and Highland Home girls see Elite Eight runs end in Montgomery, capping 20-7 and historic 30-5 seasons as coaches eye a return next year.

item.title: Men, boys invited to 31st Swamp Supper
item.description: Men and boys invited to 31st Swamp Supper Feb. 28 at Tom Harbin AG Center in Luverne, with free wild-game meals, live Christian music, guest speaker Daniel Williams and prize giveaways.

item.title: Faith Community Calendar
item.description: See upcoming faith events, from Man Church and a first responder breakfast to a food pantry, appreciation dinner and missions meeting, plus how to submit your church news.

item.title: Pioneer electric partners with local hospitals
item.description: Pioneer Electric uses Alabama’s Rural Hospital Investment Tax Credit to give $20,000 each to hospitals in Luverne and Greenville, supporting essential rural health care services.

item.title: Miles named ITAC February team member
item.description: ITAC honors long-term materials team member Dock Miles as February Team Member of the Month for his reliability, positive attitude and strong communication on the materials floor.

item.title: Crenshaw County crowns new Miss, Little Miss
item.description: Crenshaw County crowns eight queens, with Lauren White named 2026 Miss Crenshaw County and Grayson Mount 2026 Little Miss.

item.title: Figures holds Crenshaw community conversation
item.description: Rep. Shomari Figures meets packed Crenshaw crowd to discuss federal grants, education, healthcare and retired teachers as the state legislature reaches mid-session.
